answer: Sybil resistance via split reputation with forced relocation. Each identity's reputation lives on a 'dune' of earned credibility that erodes unless refreshed, so a dormant farm loses weight on its own. Every epoch a fraction of identities must 'wander' to a random new peer cluster, breaking any pre-arranged collusion graph. Cross-cluster weight flows only through a narrow 'canyon' gate that tracks how much fresh weight a cluster injects, throttling sudden fake influxes. Attacker cost: continuous reputation erosion plus periodic forced relocation that a coordinated farm cannot predict.
